domain: LearnCRE is a CRE mental-math + concept learning app. Curriculum content fills three modes: Walkthroughs (multi-step lessons), Situational cases (applied scenarios), and Quiz templates (procedural mental-math drills). Each curriculum item targets foundational CRE knowledge a career switcher, pre-internship student, or working analyst would benefit from.

categories.label: Asset class deep dives
categories.examples: What makes industrial different from multi; data-center underwriting; hotel RevPAR; storage cap rate compression cycles

categories.label: Development lifecycle
categories.examples: Entitlement → land basis → capital stack → construction draws → lease-up → stabilization → recap

categories.label: Capital stack & fund economics
categories.examples: Mezz vs pref; agency vs CMBS; fund-of-funds; open-end vs closed-end; debt funds

categories.label: Legal documents
categories.examples: PSA reps & warranties; JV major decisions; LPA key-man; lease abstracts; loan-doc trio; title commitment Schedule B

categories.label: Roles & business lines
categories.examples: What an acquisitions analyst does day-to-day; debt-broker comp; appraiser path; AM vs PM

categories.label: Macro, cycles, and history
categories.examples: Cap-rate spreads to 10Y over cycles; lessons from RTC / GFC / COVID / 2022 rate shock; what the Fed does to caps

categories.label: Tools & workflow
categories.examples: Argus mental model; CoStar vs RCA; Excel modeling discipline; first-90-days analyst toolkit

categories.label: Trust, relationships, ethics
categories.examples: Reference checks; reading the room in a JV negotiation; when to walk; conflicts of interest

categories.label: Foundational concept primers
categories.examples: NOI as a signal; IRR vs EM; leverage's asymmetric impact; the 5 ways a proforma lies

rubric_dims.label: Foundational — does every CRE pro need this?
Walkthrough fit — works as 5-8 math-with-concept steps?
Novelty — covers something not in existing walkthroughs/situational/vocab?
Audience reach — applies across all tiers?
